args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.

Hi Dana, I went through all six of Moss's digests in the share. Two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets turn up:

• #PD-4492: in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Eau Claire yard gatehouse kiosks weren't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared the gate. There's a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
• #4419: in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea filed this one too. Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I found no other QFL ticket numbers. The 9/14 North pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in both mention QFL but give no ticket numbers. #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central handoffs digest are for Marrow accounts, not QFL. Also, Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is a different company and not a customer, so I left it out. Heads up: the cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell you how current #4419's status is.

Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The note has no date, so I can't say how current that status is.

I read all six of Moss's notes. I also told Dana what I left out and why:
- The 9/14 North pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in both talk about Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central handoffs digest are for Marrow accounts.
- Quarendon Freightways (spelled with one "r") is a different company and not a Pemberline customer.

I only looked at public files that Dana can open herself. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so nothing here needed approval.
